verdict.rationale: Any product with public documentation could publish an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this axis applies to LibreOffice. The evidence shows only conventional human-oriented help pages (CLI start parameters, conversion filters) and general SDK/API docs, none of them described as an llms.txt file or as docs written for agents. Generic documentation is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
